checks.name: command palette jumps to a project
checks.goal: Press Control+K to open the command palette, type canvas, then press Enter.

checks.name: contact form explains what is missing
checks.goal: Press the Send message button in the contact form. Leave every field empty; the point is to see the validation messages.

checks.name: contact form sends a complete message
checks.goal: Fill in the contact form with the given values, wait for the spam check to finish, then press Send message.

values.Name: Jev Browser Check
values.Message: This is an automated check that the contact form delivers messages.

checks.name: Moneywell console pages through the game
checks.goal: In the Moneywell Town section, press the A button on the handheld console once.

checks.name: CV opens from the navigation
checks.goal: Open the CV page using the link in the top navigation.

checks.name: privacy policy is linked from the footer
checks.goal: Press the End key to jump to the bottom of the page, then click the Privacy link in the footer.
